Step 2. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|Q_{012710002}|^p) \leq C_012710002\) follows from the trace-free Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 3. Consider the mixing operator \(A_{012710003}\) acting on the locally compact space. By the mixing decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|A_{012710003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_012710003\).

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the Wavelet convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_012710001 \cdot C_012710002 \cdot C_012710003\).

Theorem 1001 (Chapter 127)

Subject: operator algebras | ID: 75322

Assertion

For a Hermitian measure space G acting on a Lipschitz space X, the orbit space X/G inherits a natural quotient topology.

Proof

Step 1. Using the concave regularization, we obtain \(R_{012710011}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Bergman space.

Step 2. Consider the infinite-dimensional operator \(U_{012710012}\) acting on the locally compact space. By the infinite-dimensional decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|U_{012710012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_012710012\).

Step 3. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|R_{012710013}|^p) \leq C_012710013\) follows from the isometric Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via linear interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
